name: 37343 · Hixson, TN
findings: ZIP 37343 (Hixson) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37343 (Hixson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37343 (Hixson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
